title: Stand Mixers: Tilt-Head, Bowl-Lift and Budget Picks
metaDescription: Our stand mixer research: the best mixers for occasional bakers and bread makers, comparisons and a buying guide.
lede: A stand mixer is a long-term purchase. Choose the right bowl size and design once and it can last for many years.

p: Start with the best stand mixers list. If you're choosing between the two most popular KitchenAid tilt-head models, read the Artisan vs Classic comparison.
